# Third-party SEO skill sources

Pinned revisions and file hashes are recorded in ../../skills-lock.json. Upstream source files are preserved without modification.

- openseo: https://github.com/every-app/open-seo/tree/d7ea7852480601af9bc8870942af8311a410e567. See vendored LICENSE.
- jev-seo: https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/jev-seo/tree/55a184a3b0d09565a4c84268f725a47784e62528. See vendored LICENSE.
- notfair: https://github.com/nowork-studio/notfair-plugin/tree/9afd332f421d58498ddac4fc3b41bbcd66ebe513. See vendored LICENSE.
- illyism: https://github.com/Illyism/seo-skills/tree/af48ce5953e00ca75d1cd4d440e77d0c0d61a038. MIT declared in upstream README; no separate LICENSE file provided.

Jev font licences are included in jev-seo/jevseo/fonts. Binary fonts are optional downloads with pinned hashes; the upstream renderer supports system-font fallback. Development CI workflows, screenshots and example output reports are not needed to run the installed skills and were not imported.
